code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoproteinemia. There is monocytosis and basophilia. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic disease, or hypoxic stress. Correlation with clinical context and further hematological evaluation is recommended.
